system.description: A thrall adjacent to a foe throws its arms around it and goes limp. Test Sanity (DR14). On a success, Sustained: the foe is Encumbered while the thrall clings to it. The thrall is dragged along with the foe, and the foe can tear it off only by destroying it.

outcomes.ruin: The thrall comes apart in the foe's grip and is destroyed.
